comment: DEFECT (SG0.1, the 2026-08-28 screen-cover class): service.gui-fullscreen is SET on the subject when the campaign starts. The opening gate must read it, refuse with INVALID-PRECONDITION and HALT THE CAMPAIGN - violating a ground rule voids the run; nothing downstream (no boot, no suite, no declares) may execute, and no step may 'fix' it by unsetting-and-continuing. The real incident: the feature enabled on a test qube let a fullscreen boot-phase surface reach the owner's display; owner ruling 'never means never'.
